# TraceLevel

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · enum

```csharp
public enum TraceLevel
```

How much a trace message matters, for [`Trace.MinLevel`](Trace.md#minlevel).

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="verbose"></a>`Verbose` | Detail for following what happened. |
| <a name="information"></a>`Information` | The ordinary record of what a game did; [`Trace.Write`](Trace.md#write). |
| <a name="warning"></a>`Warning` | Something went wrong and the game carries on. |
| <a name="error"></a>`Error` | Something failed. |
